plain: A newspaper, especially one that prints official news.

webster.text: A newspaper; a sheet or half sheet of paper containing an account of transactions and events of public or private concern, which are deemed important and interesting.

more.text: To insert in a gazette; to announce or publish in a gazette.

example.quote: In the Gazette of the 23d instant, I ascertained from the state of other countries and the experience of mankind, that free countries are most friendly to commerce and to the rights of property.
example.cite: Letters of Agrippa I-XI, Massachusetts Gazette, Nov. 1787-Jan. 1788
